address: 30 Henrietta Street, Covent Garden, London, WC2E 8NA, United Kingdom
bio: Named after an infamous courtesan, this elegant restaurant is set in a characterful townhouse just round the corner from what's affectionately known as “The Actors’ Church”. Inside, there’s a buzz to the atmosphere and a rich, cosy bistro feel; the concise menu focuses on seasonal British produce in fresh, unfussy and boldly flavoured dishes. Make sure you order a side of the kitchen's clever, original take on simple chips, which are utterly delicious. The smooth and attentive service team do a great job with such a busy restaurant....
